title: Attention kernel provenance & deferred activation playbook
creator: Ethan Morales
description: Problem: We observe intermittent latency spikes and low-frequency correctness regressions after enabling FlashAttention v3 kernels for long-context decodes. Root cause appears to be a combination of (a) opportunistic kernel switches during prefill->decode boundary and (b) lack of provenance metadata for how a particular kernel was selected for a request. Goal: Build a reproducible provenance and deferred activation strategy so that kernel choices are auditable, can be replayed for regression triage, and v3 activations can be gated/gradually enabled per-shard with safe rollbacks. This ticket implements the instrumentation, an experiment harness, and an operator playbook for progressive enabling of v3 kernels.
acceptance_criteria: Instrument kernel decision path so each request stores 'kernel_provenance' (selector version, heuristics, input fingerprint, score) in request trace and persisted logs.
Add a runtime flag to defer activation of v3 kernels until a safety window passes (e.g., 500 decode tokens or successful probe runs) and expose it via agent config and rollout policy.

Create an experiment harness that can route X% of traffic to deferred-v3 mode per shard and collect metrics (latency p50/p95, error rate, token-cost delta, qualitative output diffs) into the console dashboard.
Provide a documented playbook for operators to: enable deferred-v3, monitor regressions, snapshot failing traces, and perform rollback steps.
No production-facing increase in 95th percentile latency beyond 5% for experimental traffic during smoke runs (measured over 24h).
comments: 2025-02-12 - Ethan Morales: Initial investigation notes attached. Reproduced a sample trace where kernel swapped from fa2->fa3 at the first decode token causing a minor output shift. Suspect selector uses a heuristic that overweights short warm caches.

2025-02-14 - Priya Patel: Scoped deliverables. We'll focus on two parallel tracks: (1) lightweight provenance schema + trace plumbing, (2) deferred activation toggle + experiment harness. Will coordinate with observability team for dashboarding.

2025-02-18 - Design review (Lina Chen): Suggested provenance fields: selector_version, input_fingerprint (sha256), score_vector, trigger_event (prefill_complete|probe_ok|manual), and sample_decision_payload (first 128 bytes). Agreed to keep payload small to avoid telemetry explosion.

2025-02-21 - Eng note (Devon Lopez): Implemented kernel_provenance event in the in-memory trace and persisted to per-request S3 logs for 7 days. Draft PR: see attachment. Need performance microbenchmarks to confirm no token-level overhead >1%.

2025-02-25 - Observability (Riya Singh): Dashboard prototype added. Panels: kernel distribution by shard, p95 latency delta by kernel, regressions flagged by decode-diff score. Hooked to experiment tag 'deferred-v3-experiment-2025-02'.

2025-02-27 - QA (Marcus Vale): Ran a 12-hour smoke test on canary cluster with deferred activation enabled for 10% traffic. No functional regressions observed but p95 increased 3.2% on batch-heavy workloads. Need to tune deferral threshold from 500->350 tokens and re-run.

2025-03-02 - Priya Patel: Review feedback from runtime leads: add a 'probe' flow where the runtime runs 2 synthetic short decode probes per shard at low priority to validate fa3 codepaths before enabling. Also add an explicit operator command to snapshot kernel_provenance for a given request id.

2025-03-03 - Ethan Morales: Updated design to include probe flow and reduced deferral threshold. Preparing rollout plan and operator playbook. Next: coordinate with Dedicated team for larger capacity A/B test and schedule a retro if regressions surface.
